blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, ORIENTAL MINDORO, Philippines — The Philippine Statistics Authority Regional Statistical Services Office (PSA RSSO) Mimaropa placed first among the agency’s regional statistical offices in the 2025 PSA Awards held in Quezon City on Thursday, Sept. 17. In a post on Thursday, PSA Mimaropa said this recognition marked the second time the regional office had secured the top spot in the annual awards. According to the PSA regional office, the award recognized the office’s performance in delivering statistical and civil registration services in the Mimaropa (Mindoro, Marinduque, Romblon and Palawan) region.
